questions.question: On Christmas Day, December 25, 2007, how many total transit rides were logged?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('chicago_cta_daily_boardings.csv')
result = int(df.loc[df['service_date'] == '12/25/2007', 'total_rides'].iloc[0])

questions.question: Across all recorded dates, did cumulative bus boardings exceed cumulative train boardings?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('chicago_cta_daily_boardings.csv')
result = 'yes' if df['bus'].sum() > df['rail_boardings'].sum() else 'no'

questions.question: On February 1, 2010, how many more passengers boarded buses than took the train?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('chicago_cta_daily_boardings.csv')
row = df[df['service_date'] == '02/01/2010'].iloc[0]
result = int(row['bus'] - row['rail_boardings'])
